Chapter Six

# Concept of Mole and Chemical Counting

Chemistry basically deals with two kinds of analysis- qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis. Identification of an element and its properties is qualitative analysis whereas determining the amount of a substance is known as quantitative analysis. Quantitative analysis deals with calculations which altogether are denoted by the term chemical counting. These calculations usually use mole as the unit to determine the amount of a substance. In this chapter, we will discuss what is a mole, how to use moles in calculations, how to determine the cubic measurements from moles etc.
